description: This file defines data structures, methods, and constants related to product notices in the Mattermost application, including serialization, conditions, audience targeting, and external dependencies.

classes.name: ProductNotice
classes.description: Represents a product notice with conditions, ID, localized messages, and repeatability flag.

classes.name: Conditions
classes.description: Defines various conditions under which a product notice is shown, including audience, client type, version ranges, display date, server and user config, and dependencies.

classes.name: NoticeMessageInternal
classes.description: Contains the content and optional actions for a notice message, including title, description, image, and action parameters.

classes.name: NoticeMessage
classes.description: Extends NoticeMessageInternal with identifiers and visibility flags for admin roles.

classes.name: ProductNoticeViewState
classes.description: Tracks the 'viewed' state of a notice for a specific user.

classes.name: ExternalDependency
classes.description: Represents an external dependency with name and minimum version.

methods.name: UnmarshalProductNoticeMessages
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data from an io.Reader into NoticeMessages.

methods.name: SysAdminOnly
methods.description: Checks if the notice is restricted to sysadmin audience.

methods.name: TeamAdminOnly
methods.description: Checks if the notice is restricted to team admin audience.

methods.name: NewNoticeAudience
methods.description: Creates a new NoticeAudience pointer from a string.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Determines if the audience matches given sysadmin and team admin flags.

methods.name: NewNoticeClientType
methods.description: Creates a new NoticeClientType pointer from a string.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Checks if the client type matches another client type.

methods.name: NoticeClientTypeFromString
methods.description: Converts a string to a NoticeClientType, with error handling.

methods.name: NewNoticeInstanceType
methods.description: Creates a new NoticeInstanceType pointer from a value.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Checks if the instance type matches cloud or on-premise context.

methods.name: NewNoticeSKU
methods.description: Creates a new NoticeSKU pointer from a string.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Checks if the SKU matches a given string.
